bhajan.title: Allah Jehovah Jesus Christ Our Lord

discourse.excerpt: There is only one God and one Goal. You may call Allah, Jesus, Rama, Krishna, Eshwar … Though names are different, God is one. If you abuse someone, it is equivalent to abusing God. And if you love someone, it is equivalent to loving God.
discourse.theme: One God, one goal — many names; loving another is loving God.
discourse.title: Divine Message to Doctors

reflection: Swami says there is only one God and one goal, though the names are many — and loving someone is loving God. Today, let one act of care carry that love: tend someone as you would tend God. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 42, 19 Dec 2009)
seva_nudge: Check in on someone unwell today — a call, a cooked meal, or a prayer for their wellbeing — and offer the care with love, not routine.
